subject: Architecture deep-dive — prep pack, diagrams, and final slot alignment
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Bethany Li <bethany@cloudops.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@cloudops.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Architecture deep-dive — proposed slots and prep pack

Hi Bethany / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we'd like to run a focused architecture deep-dive next week to walk through the planned integration, network topology, and performance expectations. Proposed agenda and a short prep pack are attached.

Short agenda (60–75 min):
- 10m: Introductions and success criteria
- 20m: Serving runtime and deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private)
- 15m: Network/security and KMS integration (VPC peering, secure egress)
- 15m: Performance/throughput targets, batching & KV cache strategy
- 10m: Open issues and next steps / Mutual Action Plan owners

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 2026-12-09 09:00–10:15
- Thu 2026-12-10 11:30–12:45
- Fri 2026-12-11 13:00–14:15

Attachments: RDW-arch-deepdive-v0.3.pdf (slides), network-diagram.vsdx, mutual-action-plan.xlsx.

Please indicate preferred slot and any items you want added to the pre-read (e.g., specific compliance docs or network constraints). If none of the above slots work, propose two alternatives and we'll reconcile.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0112

From: Bethany Li <bethany@cloudops.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Tom Riley <tom.riley@cloudops.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 08:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive — proposed slots and prep pack

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the materials. The team has looked through the slide draft — helpful. We can't do the Wed morning slot. Thu 11:30 PT is close but we have a previously-scheduled exec update that runs long most weeks. Can we do Thu 14:00–15:15 PT instead? That would give Tom (our cloud architect) time to join after his standups.

Two requests for the pre-read:
1) Can you add a brief page about cross-region data residency and how log retention works in Private deployments (we have internal auditors who will want a short summary)?
2) Tom asked if you can attach the current VPC CIDR example and a note on recommended firewall egress rules — he's included questions below.

Tom Riley (cc): we may want to invite our infra lead if we identify network changes.

Thanks —
Bethany
Director, Platform Engineering, CloudOps Inc
 bethany@cloudops.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Bethany Li <bethany@cloudops.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@cloudops.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive — proposed slots and prep pack

Bethany —

Thu 2026-12-10 14:00–15:15 PT works for us. I'll update the calendar and send a new invite.

Action items on our side for the pre-read:
- Add a 1-slide summary on cross-region data residency + retention for Private deployments (will include whether logs leave the VPC, retention controls, and KMS notes).
- Attach example VPC CIDR and a recommended egress rules snippet.
- Add a short appendix in the slide deck listing what evidence we can provide for auditors (SOC2 references, audit logs export).

I've uploaded a v0.4 of the deck and the updated network diagram draft to Drive (links below). Will incorporate Jonas's perf numbers once he confirms.

Drive links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRDW-arch-prep
Updated deck: RDW-arch-deepdive-v0.4.pdf (in folder).

I'll send the calendar invite now.

Best,
Naomi

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>
Cc: Bethany Li <bethany@cloudops.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@cloudops.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Architecture deep-dive — proposed slots and prep pack

Naomi / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the deck. Couple of small asks from infra/perf:
- Add a slide (or appendix table) with throughput baselines for the three deployment modes at 512-token average prompt length (p50/p95 latencies, tokens/sec per GPU, and an example cost-per-1M-token figure). I'll draft numbers and push them to the Drive by EOD.
- In the network diagram, annotate where KV cache persists for Dedicated vs Private (to clarify where we recommend local SSD + snapshotting).

Also — if auditors ask about traces, include the retention window for request traces and whether we can anonymize query text in exported logs. I flagged the relevant slide.

Jonas
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.example.com>
To: Bethany Li <bethany@cloudops.com>, Tom Riley <tom.riley@cloudops.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.example.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.example.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.example.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Architecture deep-dive — calendar invite, pre-reads, and asks

Hi all —

Confirmed: Thu, 2026-12-10 14:00–15:15 PT (Google Meet). Invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-arch-sync

Pre-reads (in Drive):
- RDW-arch-deepdive-v0.4.pdf (Slides — includes data residency slide and auditor appendix)
- network-diagram-annotated.vsdx (shows KV cache placement and suggested egress rules)
- mutual-action-plan.xlsx (owners + next steps)
- perf-baselines.csv (Jonas's preliminary throughput numbers)

Requests for CloudOps before the meeting:
- Please confirm the VPC CIDR you plan to use and whether you'll need overlapping-CIDR guidance. (Tom — if you can drop that in a quick reply, we'll validate in the call.)
- If you have a short list of compliance evidence items you'd like in the appendix, paste them in this thread today so we can include them.

I'll kick off the meeting with a 2-slide success criteria check and then hand over to Jonas for perf. Please review the deck quickly — we focused the first 30 mins on the runtime/ops decisions so we can leave time for network/security specifics.

Attachments referenced in invite: RDW-arch-deepdive-v0.4.pdf; network-diagram-annotated.vsdx; mutual-action-plan.xlsx; perf-baselines.csv

See you Thursday —
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
